name: Separate Hostility
teaser: Completely fixes the hostility issue in EFT 0.16 / SPT 3.11 where bots don't fight others as they should.
description:
This mod ensures that squads will shoot other squads on sight. U*** will shoot U***, B*** will shoot B***, PMCs will shoot Scavs and so forth.

With vanilla SPT, PMCs do not shoot Scavs on sight, But will shoot them once the Scav actually lands a hit. This leads to PMCs almost always aggroing onto the player, but not Scavs.

Spawn mods either don’t fix this, or in some cases, introduce even more hostility issues, such as bosses not being hostile to other PMCs, but still being hostile to you.

NOTE: This mods makes Rogues hostile to U***. I am unable to fix this. And it makes sense anyway. Rogues are their own gang of U***, and just like how one squad of U*** will be hostile to another, so are Rogues.

Original Description Below:

Originally made as an update to Please Just Fight, however it faces a core limitation in 0.16: same-faction PMC groups won’t fight each other, only engaging opposing factions. Everyone lives in a big happy family.

To fix this, the mod was fully rewritten with patches that:

Split PMC mega groups into individual ones (per bot and per spawn group setting).

Remove faction-based hostility restrictions.

Result: PMCs now engage any hostile target, including former allies, enabling true free-for-all combat, while keeping their spawn group settings.

Do note that I tend to kill everyone so there’s no distinguishing for U*** player and rogues. Kill em all.

Details: Hostility is group based. Bots are spawned into same role group, regardless of their spawn group setting (duo, trio, solo, quad…). For example, the game spawned a duo U*** squad, a trio U*** squad, and 2 solo U***. The result is they are all added into one big U*** group that they won’t fight each other. You can set bots as enemy even within their own big group, but that would break any spawn group settings and is practically bad.

This mod was made back in June when I was still playing SPT.
